text:
Tejas Rai
Professional Summary 
Learning & Development and Sales Enablement professional with 15+ years of
experience across MNC, BFSI, BPO and education environments, including 4+
years of corporate training experience and 2+ years leading sales training in
the health insurance industry.
Experienced in leading training teams, managing end-to-end learning
interventions, and building sales capability through New Hire Training, refresher
programs, Training Needs Analysis (TNA/TNI), OJT and field coaching.
Currently leading a team of training professionals and partnering with Sales,
Operations, HR and business stakeholders to align learning initiatives with
business and productivity goals.
Strong expertise in sales capability development, product/process training,
performance coaching, learner engagement and training effectiveness.
Hands-on experience in designing training content, facilitator guides,
assessments and learning interventions based on identified performance
gaps.
Leverages AI tools, Excel, automation and data-driven reporting to improve
training productivity, learning effectiveness and business outcomes.
